description: Voice and video calling between users with call management and history.

screens_added.name: Incoming Call
screens_added.purpose: Full-screen incoming call with accept and decline

screens_added.name: Active Call
screens_added.purpose: Voice or video call screen with controls

screens_added.name: Call History
screens_added.purpose: All past calls — missed, incoming, outgoing

screens_added.name: Call Settings
screens_added.purpose: Audio, video, and notification preferences for calls

flows_added: Initiate call → ring → recipient accepts → connected → end call → summary
Receive incoming call → full-screen overlay → accept or decline
Voice call → upgrade to video → switch camera → mute → end
interaction_patterns: Incoming call — full-screen overlay, never a banner
Mute — fills with red when active, always visible
Camera toggle — indicator always shows whether camera is on
Speaker toggle — prominent, especially for voice calls
End call — always red, always in the same position
Call duration timer — always visible during active call
Tap to show or hide controls during video call

error_flows.ui: Can not join with video/audio. Show specific missing permission. CTA: direct link to browser/device settings. Option: 'Join without camera' if audio-only is acceptable. Never silently join muted with no camera — be explicit about state.

Connection quality indicator in corner: green/amber/red bars. At amber: 'Your connection is unstable — the other person may experience issues'. At red: 'Poor connection — switching to audio only'. Auto-degrade video quality before dropping to audio.
Full-screen: 'Call disconnected'. Duration shown. Rejoin button. Option to call back. If all parties dropped: show who was on the call. Never return to home screen silently.

error_flows.trigger: Other party's camera or mic fails mid-call
error_flows.ui: Show video placeholder with their name and camera-off icon. Audio indicator still shows if they're speaking. Never show frozen last frame as if still live.
After 30 seconds no answer: 'No answer'. CTA: 'Try again' or 'Send a message'. Call logged in history as 'Missed'. Never show endless ringing with no timeout.

End of call: 'Recording could not be saved — storage issue'. Explain why if possible. If recording was promised to participants: notify all that recording is unavailable. Never silently lose a recording.

edge_cases.case: User joins call from multiple devices simultaneously
edge_cases.ui: Second device shows: 'You are already in this call on another device. Join here and disconnect the other?' Explicit choice. Never allow silent multi-device join — audio echo risk.

edge_cases.case: Call scheduled but organiser hasn't joined yet
edge_cases.ui: Waiting room shows: 'Waiting for [organiser name] to start the call'. Timer showing how long since scheduled start. Leave option always available. Never strand participants indefinitely.

edge_cases.case: Group call where all but one participant leaves
edge_cases.ui: Show: 'Everyone else has left the call'. Options: 'End call' or 'Stay on'. Auto-end after 60 seconds with no action. Never leave user on an empty call indefinitely.

edge_cases.case: Screen share shows sensitive content accidentally
edge_cases.ui: Screen share always requires explicit start confirmation: 'You are about to share your entire screen — make sure no sensitive content is visible'. Stop sharing button always prominent during share.

edge_cases.case: Incoming call while user is already on a call
edge_cases.ui: Incoming call banner at top: caller name and decline/hold-and-answer options. Never auto-answer second call. First call put on hold explicitly, not silently.

edge_cases.case: Call participant uses a very slow device (high CPU)
edge_cases.ui: Auto-reduce received video quality for that participant. Their feed stays visible but at lower resolution. Never cause their app to crash by sending too high a stream.

classification_note: Secondary. Inferred when description mentions 'video', 'call', 'telehealth', 'virtual', 'live session'.
